## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Core Python tests pass.
- [ ] Lifter oracle tests pass, or the change cannot affect the lifter.
- [ ] Native clean build and round trip pass, or the change cannot affect native output.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, certificates, generated artifacts, or user-specific data are included.

## Release impact

Describe compatibility, security, artifact-provenance, and rollback implications.
